title: Pre-paint theme boot
summary: Inline script for index.html head that reads nodemode_ui_settings and writes the profile colours, accent and light-theme body class before first paint. This is the whole mechanism behind no theme flash on hard reload. Must stay in step with the THEMES table.
description: Runs synchronously before the body exists, after the critical inline style block and before any stylesheet link. It holds a compact PROFILES table (the ten surface values per theme id plus the derived node background), applies them with `style.setProperty` on `documentElement`, paints `html` with the profile background, and uses a MutationObserver to add `body.theme-light` the instant the body appears. A second inline script in the same file writes the terminal dock open state and height (`data-ft-dock`, `--ft-dock-size`) before first paint so the dock row is reserved. The formai-design-lang skill ships a copy of this snippet as `theme-boot.js` (outside the formvis repo; not listed in files).
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

invariants.text: The persisted appearance key is nodemode_ui_settings and is shared with NodeMode by contract; its name and the appearance generation field must not change.

Build a node once, then patch text, classes, hidden flags and lists in place. Never assign innerHTML or clear textContent on a live container to rebuild it, and reserve space so nothing shifts when content arrives.
The boot script is inline in the head after the critical style block and before every stylesheet link; it must not be deferred or moved into the bundle.
Every storage read is wrapped in try/catch and the defaults are correct when storage is blocked.
